# UPP 'North Stars'
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the unit's lore primer.
[italic]The Union of Progressive Peoples Naval Infantry (UPP), under the 5th Fleet of the 5th Division, is known as the 'North Stars.' Drawn from Chinese (former CANC), Russian, German, and Spanish conscripts, the unit is considered one of the most culturally diverse formations in the UPP, even among the 5th Fleet. The 'North Stars' are regarded as underfunded, even by UPP standards, yet despite this, they continue to demonstrate an undying loyalty to the party.[/italic]
